title: Project Stargate — the CIA's $20 million psychic spy program
voiceover: From 1978 to 1995, the CIA ran a secret program training people to spy with their minds. It was called Project Stargate. Officially, they spent over 20 million dollars on it. They trained psychics they called remote viewers, who would sit in a quiet room and try to mentally locate enemy submarines, hostages, and missile silos. They claimed hits. They claimed misses. The program was officially declassified in 1995 — and shut down — after a review found the results inconsistent. But the documents are public now. You can read them. Decide for yourself if it really didn't work. Follow Mindbloom for one fact a day.
